Liquidity and Liquidation Levels.

Key Liquidity Levels

  • Downside Key Level: 83.5k – 85k
  • Immediate Resistance: 88.5k – 89.2k
  • Major Short-Squeeze Zone: 92k – 96k

The heatmap shows price recently flushed into a major long-liquidation zone (84–86k), indicating longs were hunted. Above price, a wide liquidity band (~93–96k) marks large short-liquidation pools, meaning any upward move could trigger a squeeze.

The liquidation map confirms this: downside long liquidity is mostly cleared, while over $2B in short liquidations sit above. Together, this suggests the market has punished longs already, and any strength could ignite a short-squeeze rally, while continued weakness risks another long flush.

Conclusive Insights

Technical Outlook

  • November delivered no relief as BTC trended in a straight, uninterrupted decline, reflecting persistent market weakness.
  • While sub-80k has acted as temporary support, the absence of strong inflows keeps the bounce unreliable.
  • Holding above 80k may produce a short-term rebound, but failure to do so opens the door toward the deeper confluence zone at 65k, aligned with weekly liquidity clusters.

Fundamental Outlook

  • Hopes for a QT pause and a potential December rate cut helped BTC form a short-term base.
  • However, the combination of BOJ’s hawkish stance and reduced U.S. Treasury purchases by China & Japan triggered renewed macro volatility.
  • As a result, global markets remain in a fragile, uncertain phase, limiting strong trend continuation.
